## FAQ


**Q: How much does it cost to use this?**
> A: Groq offers a free tier with generous limits. Check [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com) for current pricing.

**Q: Can I use a different LLM?**
> A: Yes! Replace the ChatGroq instance in agent.py with ChatOpenAI, ChatAnthropic, or other LangChain providers.

**Q: How long does an interview take?**
> A: Average interview takes 2-3 minutes. Can be customized by modifying number of questions in agent.py.

**Q: Can I save candidate responses?**
> A: Currently responses are stored in memory. Add a database integration to persist data.

**Q: Is this production-ready?**
> A: It's a solid foundation. For production, add authentication, database, error monitoring, and security measures.

**Q: How do I customize the questions?**
> A: Edit the PromptManager in prompts.py to modify prompt templates.

**Q: Can I run this locally without internet?**
> A: No, it requires API calls to Groq. You can modify it to use local LLMs like Ollama.

**Q: What Python versions are supported?**
> A: Python 3.13+. Earlier versions may have compatibility issues with typing_extensions.

**Q: How do I add support for new fields?**
> A: Add the field to ConversationState, create a node in the graph, add prompts, and update app.py UI.

**Q: Can I deploy this to production?**
> A: Yes! Recommended approach: Docker + Streamlit Cloud or your own server with Nginx reverse proxy.

### 2. Real-Time Conversational Scoring


GPT-4.1 evaluates each answer in real time, assigning a `score_delta` (-8 to +8) and tagging it to a rubric dimension:

| Score Delta | Meaning |
|---|---|
| +6 to +8 | Detailed, technically correct, specific answer |
| +3 to +5 | Adequate with some correct detail |
| +1 to +2 | Vague or partial |
| 0 | Off-topic or no real content |
| -2 to -4 | Wrong information or significant gap |
| -5 to -8 | Completely incorrect or evasive |

**Anti-inflation rule**: "Main machine chalata hoon" (I operate the machine) with no detail → 0 or negative. Vague answers are never rewarded.

**Rubric weights for garment workers:**

| Rubric Dimension | Weight |
|---|---|
| Stitch quality | 32% |
| Machine familiarity | 26% |
| Technical knowledge | 24% |
| Fabric & material knowledge | 12% |
| Communication & confidence | 6% |
